summary: Payment refactor (gateway lama removed → cash / piutang / transfer_va gateway lama placeholder) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 18/18 pass. Playwright verified all 3 method cards, cash & piutang checkout flows, disabled Transfer VA (Segera hadir badge), PaymentPage placeholder + switch-method, admin pages render with new labels, receipt/checkout/homepage free of COD/gateway lama/QRIS/E-Wallet.

issues: Descriptive help copy still contains phrase 'Lunas / COD & piutang selesai' though COD payment method has been removed. Not user-facing to customers, but staff-facing copy is inaccurate. Suggest updating to 'Lunas / piutang selesai' or 'Pesanan lunas & piutang selesai'.

action_items: (Minor) Update owner dashboard & laporan help copy strings referencing 'COD' now that COD is removed.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/payments.py: switching payment method uses order.payment_method = body.payment_method or order.payment_method. If body.payment_method is None Pydantic would validate; but PaymentMethod Literal will reject None cleanly. OK.

customer.py checkout deducts stock BEFORE build_charge; if build_charge raises after stock deduction (e.g. NotImplementedError from a future provider), the flush/commit-or-rollback pattern still handles it via session rollback since commit not yet called — but movements list is appended in loop. Reviewed: acceptable because db.commit happens only after apply_charge.
PaymentPage: polling interval 8s only for pending; ok. Timer.current cleared on unmount.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 test orders via API/UI: TEST_ui_cash_buyer, TEST_ui_piutang_buyer, TEST_ui_va_buyer plus 2 pytest-generated orders per method (cash, piutang, transfer_va).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment refactor complete. /api/admin/receivables returns {total,count,orders:[…]} — not a bare list. Legacy /api/payments/{order}/simulate and /api/payments/gateway lama/notification are 404 (routes removed). /api/payments/gateway lama/notification returns 503 while gateway-lama_* env unset. PaymentMethod schemas.Literal rejects legacy methods with 422 at pydantic layer. UI checkout cart seed key is localStorage 'mbg_cart_v1'.
